<title level="1" right="Class Feature 9">[Champion Expertise](/Classes.aspx?ID=4)</title>

<column gap="tiny">
**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 104

**Class** Champion
</column>

---

Prayers strengthen your divine power. Your proficiency ranks for your champion class DC and divine spell attack rolls and DCs increase to expert.
